abilities.name: Healing Dart
abilities.description: Fire a dart which heals the first allied Hero hit for 195 Health. Does not affect full Health Heroes.

abilities.name: Biotic Grenade
abilities.description: Toss a Grenade at the target area. Allied Heroes hit are healed for 152 Health and receive 25% increased healing from Ana for 4 seconds. Enemies hit take 60 damage and receive 100% less healing for 1.75 seconds. If Biotic Grenade does not hit any enemies, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and if Ana is the only target hit, reduce its cooldown by an additional 2 seconds.

fields.type: Spell damage, Healing received modifier / Healing / Healing dealt modifier
fields.notes: Healing modifiers are applied after damage and healing are dealt. Enemy healing reduction stacks additively with healing modifiers that affect healing received by the target. Ally healing bonus stacks additively with healing modifiers affecting healing dealt by Ana and multiplicatively with healing received modifiers on the target.

abilities.name: Sleep Dart
abilities.description: Fire a dart that puts the first enemy Hero hit to Sleep, Stunning them for 3 seconds. Sleep's effects end instantly if the target takes damage after the first 0.5 seconds. Cannot be used on Vehicles.

fields.notes: Sleep counts as a Stun effect and interacts with all effects that interact with Stuns. Damage over time effects applied beforehand do not interrupt Sleep.

abilities.name: Nano Boost
abilities.description: Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster. yellowtext Cannot be used on Ana.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier, Mana
fields.notes: Spell Power stacks additively with other sources of Spell Power and other damage and healing modifiers affecting the target hero's Spell Damage or healing output. Stacks additively with other effects that affect cooldown rerfresh rate.

abilities.name: Eye of Horus
abilities.description: Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225 and enemies are damaged for 135. Deals 50% less damage to Structures. Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.

fields.notes: Eye of Horus can be canceled after 0.5 seconds through the 'W' or 'E' key. If Eye of Horus is canceled or interrupted before any shots are fired, it will not be put on cooldown. Ana cannot move, Mount, Hearth or use other abilities while channeling Eye of Horus. Channel can last indefinitely and will only end if interrupted, manually canceled or once all shots have been fired.

abilities.name: Eye of Horus - High Powered Round
abilities.description: Fire a specialized round with unlimited range, piercing all allied and enemy Heroes in its path. Allies are healed for 225 and enemies are damaged for 135. Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

fields.notes: Can be activated using the 'Q', 'R' or left mouse button during Eye of Horus. Using High Powered Round briefly provides vision around the line of fire and upon hitting around the targets.

talents.name: Contact Healing
talents.description: Hitting Heroes with Biotic Grenade increases its damage and healing by 30% Hero hit.

fields.notes: Gains bonuses from both allied and enemy Heroes hit. Stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Biotic Grenade 's damage. Stacks additively with itself and other healing dealt modifiers that can affect Biotic Grenade 's healing.

_raw_fields: Hitting Heroes with Biotic Grenade increases its damage and healing by 30% Hero hit.

talents.name: Slumber Shells
talents.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sleep Dart by 2 seconds. Upon waking, enemy Heroes are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds.
_raw_fields: Reduce the cooldown of Sleep Dart by 2 seconds. Upon waking, enemy Heroes are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Vampiric Rounds
talents.description: Increase Shrike's healing by 15% Quest Stack 5 Doses on an enemy Hero or Basic Attack a Hero with 5 Doses. Stack 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 1%. reward Basic Attack a Hero with 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 0.25%

fields.notes: Stacks additively with itself and baseline healing from Shrike.

talents.name: Biotic Enhancements
talents.description: Increase the bonus healing duration of Biotic Grenade by 50% and reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds.
_raw_fields: Increase the bonus healing duration of Biotic Grenade by 50% and reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds.

talents.name: Overdose
talents.description: Sleep Dart applies 4 Doses. While Aim Down Sights is active, Sleep Dart pierces all enemy Heroes.
_raw_fields: Sleep Dart applies 4 Doses. While Aim Down Sights is active, Sleep Dart pierces all enemy Heroes.

talents.name: Debilitating Dart
talents.description: Cooldown 20 Active Activate to fire a dart which Slows the Movement Speed and reduces the damage dealt by the first enemy Hero it hits by 50% for 4 seconds. If no Heroes are hit reduce this cooldown by 8 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage reduction stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting the target hero's damage output.

_raw_fields: Cooldown 20 Active Activate to fire a dart which Slows the Movement Speed and reduces the damage dealt by the first enemy Hero it hits by 50% for 4 seconds. If no Heroes are hit reduce this cooldown by 8 seconds.

talents.name: Anti-Healer
talents.description: Increase the area of Biotic Grenade by 25% and the duration of the healing reduction by 0.75 seconds.

fields.notes: 25% increase in radius, therefore actually a 56% increase in area.

_raw_fields: Increase the area of Biotic Grenade by 25% and the duration of the healing reduction by 0.75 seconds.

talents.name: Night Terrors
talents.description: Gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds for every Hero hit by Sleep Dart. Upon waking, enemy Heroes take 8% of their maximum Health in damage.

fields.notes: Speed bonus amount does not stack, only duration does.

_raw_fields: Gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds for every Hero hit by Sleep Dart. Upon waking, enemy Heroes take 8% of their maximum Health in damage.

talents.name: Mind-Numbing Agent
talents.description: Every Dose a Hero has reduces their Spell Power by 10%.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier
fields.notes: Spell Power stacks additively with itself, other sources of Spell Power and other damage and healing modifiers affecting the target hero's Spell Damage or healing output.

talents.name: Purifying Darts
talents.description: Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.

fields.notes: Healing bonus stacks additively with other healing dealt modifiers that can affect Healing Dart 's healing.

_raw_fields: Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.

talents.name: Smelling Salts
talents.description: Healing Dart removes Stuns from the target, and grants them 50 Armor for 2 seconds when doing so.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Healing Dart removes Stuns from the target, and grants them 50 Armor for 2 seconds when doing so.

talents.name: Sharpshooter
talents.description: Healing Dart's healing is increased by 5% if it heals a Hero, up to 50%. At maximum bonus, further increase its healing by 35%. This bonus is reset if Healing Dart fails to hit a Hero.

fields.notes: If Aim Down Sights is active, only the first Hero healed by each Healing Dart grants a stack. If Healing Dart passes through at least one allied Hero, no stacks will be lost even if they are at full Health. For a stack to be gained it must actually heal at least one Hero, however. Healing bonus stacks additively with itself and other healing dealt modifiers that can affect Healing Dart 's healing.

talents.name: Concentrated Doses

fields.notes: Healing bonus stacks additively with itself and other healing dealt modifiers that can affect Healing Dart 's healing.

_raw_fields: Increase Healing Dart's healing by 12% for each Dose active on enemy Heroes.

talents.name: Active Reload
talents.description: Cooldown 60 Active Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.

fields.notes: Cannot hold more than 3 charges at any time. Activating Active Reload instantly refreshes the cooldown of Healing Dart. Charges last indefinitely, but cooldown doesn't start until all charges have been consumed.

_raw_fields: Cooldown 60 Active Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.

talents.name: Nano Infusion
talents.description: Allies affected by Nano Boost heal for 50% of Spell Damage dealt.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other sources of lifesteal.

_raw_fields: Allies affected by Nano Boost heal for 50% of Spell Damage dealt.

talents.name: Deadeye
talents.description: Eye of Horus's cooldown is reduced to 6 seconds, but it only regains charges every 10 seconds. Remaining cooldown is converted to rounds. For every Hero Eye of Horus hits, increase its healing and damage by 5%. This bonus resets after leaving Eye of Horus or after 4 seconds.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier
fields.notes: Both damage and healing share the same bonus value. Bonus updates after all damage and healing for the shot has been dealt, and only affects the following shots. Stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers and healing dealt modifiers that can affect Eye of Horus 's damage or healing.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier / Defensive damage modifier

talents.description: Basic Attacks increase Attack Speed by 10% for 3 seconds, up to 100%. While Aim Down Sights is active, increase your Basic Attack Range by 4.

other.name: Shrike
other.description: Basic Attacks apply a Dose to enemies, dealing 40 damage over 5 seconds plus additional damage equal to the current number of stacks on the target, stacking up to 5 times. Every 0.5 seconds, Ana is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Shrike. Aim Down Sights Cooldown 4 Activating Shrike reduces your Movement Speed by 25%, but increases the range of Healing Dart and Sleep Dart by 25% while also allowing them to pierce one Hero. Lasts until canceled.; trait
